evidence.paraphrase: The page presents a high-frequency business-conditions measure designed to update the current state of the U.S. economy as heterogeneous releases arrive.
Inputs are weekly initial unemployment claims; monthly payroll employment, industrial production, real income less transfers, and real manufacturing and trade sales; and quarterly real GDP.
A state-space framework reconciles asynchronous observations into a common business-condition index and updates the estimate when new or revised data become available.
Archived vintages and the tentacle visualization expose how the contemporaneous state estimate changes as later releases and revisions expand the information set.

executive_summary: The Philadelphia Fed ADS index estimates a high-frequency latent U.S. business-condition state from six indicators arriving at weekly, monthly, and quarterly frequencies. Its real-time vintages and tentacle plot make revisions and ragged-edge uncertainty part of the evidence. MacroTrace should implement it as a mixed-frequency state-space node whose release-by-release state changes are traceable, not as a static descriptive composite.

method_routes.aggregation_role: core activity-state node with release-news lineage and vintage uncertainty visible
diagnostic_requirements: real-time nowcast error and revision decomposition
method_routes.estimand: latent U.S. business-condition state conditional on the exact information set available at each date
method_routes.formula: x_{j,t}=lambda_j ADS_t+e_{j,t}; ADS_t=A(L)ADS_{t-1}+u_t; Kalman filter handles mixed-frequency missing observations
method_routes.identification_strategy: measurement and transition equations map multiple activity indicators to a common latent state; predictive/state estimation rather than causal identification
identifying_assumptions: release calendars and vintages are faithfully reconstructed
measurement loadings and transition dynamics are stable enough for filtering
missing observations enter as ragged edge rather than imputed future values
method_routes.sample_definition: real-time weekly, monthly, and quarterly U.S. activity vintages available on each historical date

questions.horizon_text: current high-frequency business state and near-term update path
questions.question_text: What is the current latent state of U.S. business conditions when weekly, monthly, and quarterly activity indicators arrive asynchronously and are subsequently revised?
